purpose: Teach: 桐/天狗/ダニ/シティー/飛び込み/海水浴/リハビリテーション/ヘビ

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、桐の箪笥を新調したって、メイちゃん
lines.en: A customer came in and mentioned they'd just bought a new paulownia wood chest.
lines.style: Warm, conversational sharing. Soft opening. Gentle pace — like mentioning something observed and worth noting. A small smile in the voice.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、お子様に天狗の絵本を読まれたって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Oh, and they were telling me about reading their child a tengu storybook.
lines.style: Engaged, building on the thought. Light and interested tone. Unhurried. The slight lilt of someone finding these details charming.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お店にダニが出ないよう掃除を徹底しましょう、メイちゃん
lines.en: We should really make sure the shop stays clean — keep the mites away.
lines.style: Gentle but practical directive. Not commanding, more suggesting together. Clear and steady. A note of care in the voice.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、都会のシティーホテルに泊まったって、メイちゃん
lines.en: They mentioned staying at a nice city hotel recently too.
lines.style: Continuing the thread of conversation. Thoughtful tone. Mid-pace. A slight wonder at how many stories one customer carries.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、プールの飛び込みのお話されてたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: And apparently they were talking about diving at the pool — sounded like they were enjoying it.
lines.style: Pleased, almost delighted. Slightly lifted at 'diving'. Warm curiosity. The tone of someone glad to hear others are having good experiences.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、夏は海水浴のお客様で混みそうね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Summer's going to be busy with swimmers stopping by, isn't it?
lines.style: Musing, slightly anticipatory. Warm forecast rather than complaint. Relaxed pace. A little knowing laugh beneath the words.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、リハビリテーション施設のお仕事だって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Turned out they work at a rehabilitation facility.
lines.style: Registering the detail with quiet respect. A small pause before delivering it. Steady, noting something that matters. Warm without over-explaining.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お子様、ヘビのおもちゃに興味津々ね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Their child's fascinated by the toy snake — keeps looking at it.
lines.style: Gentle delight. Warm observation of something small and genuine. Soft, almost conspiratorial tone — the pleasure of noticing what a child notices.
